_about: Ported from qwqcode/SubRenamer SubRenamer.Tests/MatcherTests/TopLevelTests.json (GPL-2.0, https://github.com/qwqcode/SubRenamer). Translation rule: each row's Video/Subtitle becomes an entry in the corresponding `videos`/`subtitles` list; each Output row with both Video and Subtitle non-empty becomes an `expected_pairs` entry. Rows where one side is empty in Output are left out of `expected_pairs`, which causes `tests/corpus.rs` to assert those entries end up in the unmatched set.

cases.name: BlackDoor (with parentheses)
cases.wontfix_reason: diff algorithm limitation: video cores `(S01)` and `(S11)` after LCP/LCS become `01`/`11`; subtitle cores `S01E01` and `S01E11` after LCP/LCS become `01`/`11`. (S11) video still aligns to E01 subtitle by mistake. Requires matcher rewrite (out of scope).

cases.name: Haikyuu!! (with multiple languages, one-to-many)
cases.wontfix_reason: diff algorithm limitation: video cores after LCP/LCS are `S2 - 09`/`S2 - 10`, subtitle cores are `09`/`10`. The `S2 - ` prefix on the video side prevents direct alignment; cross-side alignment fails. Requires matcher rewrite (out of scope).
